paper_diagnosis: Disseminated coccidioidomycosis in an immunocompetent male who lived in an endemic region in the remote past
disease_label_per_paper: Pulmonary coccidioidomycosis with pleural disease and meningeal dissemination
presentation_summary: 39-year-old previously healthy Hispanic man presented with two weeks of shortness of breath, dry cough, and fever.
He had intermittent headaches and unintentional weight loss of about 10 pounds over two months.
He had migrated from Mexico to Michigan about two years earlier and had worked construction while living in Mexico.
At presentation he had maximal temperature 103 F, heart rate 126/min, respiratory rate 24/min, and decreased breath sounds with dullness over the left middle/lower lung fields.
Chest imaging showed a large left pleural effusion and consolidation; broad antibacterial therapy did not resolve fever or dyspnea.
Open lung/pleural tissue showed necrotizing granulomas with Coccidioides spherules and culture grew Coccidioides immitis; later CSF testing showed coccidioidal meningitis.

imaging.finding: Moderate to large left pleural effusion with consolidation; no lung nodule, mass, cavity, or lymphadenopathy
imaging.source_text_value: Computed tomography (CT) of the chest with contrast revealed moderate to large left pleural effusion associated with consolidation. CT chest did not reveal any lung nodule, mass, cavity, or lymphadenopathy.
Subsequent neurological examination and CT brain were unremarkable

pathology.result: Necrotizing granulomas with Coccidioides spherules containing endospores on H&E, PAS, and GMS
pathology.source_text_value: Histopathological examination ... showed extensive necrotizing granulomas ... H&E stains revealed numerous large round-to-oval spherules ... PAS and GMS further highlighted the spherules filled with endospores

confirmatory_findings.finding: Pulmonary/pleural coccidioidomycosis proven by tissue spherules and culture
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: Periodic acid-Schiff and Grocott's methenamine silver stain highlighted spherules filled with endospores; fungal culture grew Coccidioides immitis

confirmatory_findings.finding: Meningeal dissemination supported by CSF coccidioidal antibody and inflammatory CSF profile
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: CSF analysis revealed the presence of CSF coccidioidomycosis IgG antibody confirming dissemination to meninges

actual_treatment: initial broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotics for presumed complicated pneumonia
oral fluconazole 800 mg daily after pulmonary tissue diagnosis
intravenous amphotericin B 4 mg/kg every 24 hours after clinical deterioration and CSF dissemination

outcome.source_text_value: The patient has been closely monitored in the outpatient clinic since and has been asymptomatic with a decline of serial antibody titers for the last 20 months.
